api_host.description: URL of the e-securemail administration console (e.g. 'https://www.security-mail.net')

description: SECUSERVE is a French managed service provider for email security. e-securemail filters inbound and outbound messages of more than 12000 organizations against spam, phishing and malware. This module collects the filtering events of a domain from the e-securemail SIEM API.
name: SECUSERVE
